var black = [[Bool]](repeating: [Bool](repeating: false, count: 11), count: 11)
var r = 5, c = 5, direction = 0
let dr = [-1, 0, 1, 0], dc = [0, 1, 0, -1]
for _ in 0..<300 {
    direction = (direction + (black[r][c] ? 3 : 1)) % 4
    black[r][c].toggle()
    r = (r + dr[direction] + 11) % 11
    c = (c + dc[direction] + 11) % 11
